# jpeg-js decoder provenance

`decoder.cjs` is an unmodified copy of `lib/decoder.js` from the reviewed
`jpeg-js` 0.4.4 package. Only the decoder is included; the package's encoder,
entry point, declarations, and development files are not distributed here.

- Package: `jpeg-js@0.4.4`
- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/eugeneware/jpeg-js>
- Reviewed package: <https://registry.npmjs.org/jpeg-js/-/jpeg-js-0.4.4.tgz>
- Reviewed package SHA-256: `269f988267bc71efe58baf97e8b2da064b5bbbbb8b0eab11e2149049935e1160`
- Decoder SHA-256: `a3f175fd6f62d142aad94d3bd90f3a30be4e076baf9b6a6fa31c8e84d9d4aa9f`
- Package license file SHA-256: `c0a8512eabe960492fefd4f287523eb3b5ca1518ca37ef0ec83344cd7f089cb8`

The package identifies itself as BSD-3-Clause. The decoder source retains its
Apache-2.0 copyright and license header, so both license texts accompany it.
